title: README demo and feature links point to anthusai.github.io/Markus instead of markus.anth.us
description:
**Problem**
The README sends readers to the old GitHub Pages address instead of the canonical site markus.anth.us.

**Evidence**
- README.md:50 links the feature index to `https://anthusai.github.io/Markus/articles/features.html`
- README.md:70 links the demo to `https://anthusai.github.io/Markus/`

**Fix**
Replace both with the markus.anth.us equivalents (https://markus.anth.us/ and https://markus.anth.us/articles/features.html, after confirming the path exists).

**How to verify**
`grep -n 'anthusai.github.io/Markus' README.md` returns nothing and `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -L https://markus.anth.us/articles/features.html` returns 200.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
